title: Choose the Computational Health Lab logo direction
question: Which identity idea should we refine as the laboratory logo? This round decides only the mark and wordmark, not the application interface.

options.label: Evidence Gate
options.lineage: evidence paths resolving into one verified point
options.thesis: Different computational signals converge into one result that remains open to inspection.
options.viewport: A compact open gate receives several paths and holds one verified point.
options.risk: The incoming paths must be simplified further so the smallest icon does not feel busy.

options.label: Resolved Layers
options.lineage: transparent analytical planes and traceable overlays
options.thesis: Independent layers overlap to reveal a shared evidence cell.
options.viewport: Three partial frames interlock around a central unresolved space.
options.risk: Interlocking frames are familiar in technology branding and may not be distinctive enough.

options.label: CHL Structure
options.lineage: a custom structural monogram built from the laboratory initials
options.thesis: The laboratory name becomes the mark, with no separate scientific metaphor to explain.
options.viewport: C, H, and L share one compact silhouette beside the full laboratory name.
options.risk: The current construction is too literal and corporate; a chosen version would need custom redrawing.
